part.text:
Implemented the fix in `src/Illuminate/Validation/Concerns/FormatsMessages.php`.

`getFromLocalArray()` now returns `null` when an attribute-level custom message array lacks the requested rule, allowing custom rules to fall back to their own failure messages instead of leaking the entire message array into the `MessageBag`.

Validation suite passes: **822 tests, 2883 assertions**.
